common.phaseNote: This workspace is being delivered in phases. Values shown here come from stored records only.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to continue your bid-readiness work.
auth.registerSubtitle: Start with your business details. You can complete the rest as you go.
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with one letter and one number.
auth.termsNote: Your uploaded documents stay private to your company and are never exposed through public links.
auth.otpSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code to continue securely.
auth.otpSentBody: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth.otpExpiry: The code can be used once. Check spam if it has not arrived.

onboarding.title: Tell us what your business can deliver
onboarding.subtitle: These details drive tender matching and evidence checks. Every field can be updated later.
onboarding.companySubtitle: The legal basics we use across every assessment.
onboarding.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly describe your products, services and typical projects.
onboarding.capabilitiesSubtitle: Use short tags so matching stays explainable.
onboarding.evidenceSubtitle: Upload reusable documents. They stay private and can support future tenders.
onboarding.noDocs: No evidence documents yet. You can add them now or from the Documents page.
onboarding.reviewSubtitle: You can start using BidKaro with the information you have provided.
onboarding.missing: Some fields are still empty. Tender assessments will show which information is missing.
onboarding.saveFailed: We could not save your profile. Check the form and try again.
onboarding.evidenceNote: A document accepted for one tender never automatically satisfies another. Evidence is checked per requirement.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is what needs your attention across your bids.
dashboard.noActions: Nothing urgent. Add a tender to start an assessment.
dashboard.noTendersHint: Discover a tender or add one manually to begin a source-cited assessment.
dashboard.noDeadlines: No deadlines in the next 14 days.
dashboard.noActivity: Activity will appear as you build your workspace.
dashboard.profileHint: Complete more fields to improve matching and evidence checks.
dashboard.bannerTitle: Let BidKaro prepare your next bid, faster
dashboard.bannerBody: Discover a tender, extract cited requirements and turn them into an actionable checklist.

documents.title: Document library
documents.subtitle: Reusable company evidence with its own metadata and verification state.
documents.uploadSubtitle: Files stay private to your company. PDF, PNG or JPG up to 25 MB.
documents.drop: Drop a file here, or browse
documents.supported: PDF, PNG, JPG or JPEG · max 25 MB
documents.deleteBody: The file and its metadata will be removed. This cannot be undone.
documents.emptyBody: Upload registrations, financial statements, completion certificates or other evidence.
documents.fileTooLarge: Files must be 25 MB or smaller.
documents.invalidType: Only PDF, PNG, JPG and JPEG files are accepted.

company.title: Company profile
company.subtitle: The capability and evidence profile used for tender matching.
company.completenessHint: Missing fields are shown as gaps, never treated as failures.
company.missingFields: Complete more fields to strengthen future assessments.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace preferences and account details.
settings.languageHint: Changing language does not change stored records, source text or calculations.
settings.themeHint: Use light or dark mode across the workspace.
settings.securityNote: Documents are served only through authenticated endpoints. Public links are never created.
settings.signOutBody: You will need your email and password to sign back in.
settings.emailSignInOn: A 6-digit code is required after your password.
settings.emailSignInOff: Password-only sign-in is enabled for this account.
settings.securityModalBody: Enter your current password to change how you sign in.
settings.remindersHint: Deadlines, tasks and evidence expiry dates generated from stored records.
settings.emailRemindersOn: Due reminders are emailed when the send-reminders job runs.
settings.emailRemindersOff: Email delivery is off. In-app reminders still appear.
settings.emailNotConfigured: SMTP is not configured on this server, so the email job cannot send yet.
settings.leadDaysHint: Choose how many days before a deadline a reminder is due.

tenders.title: My tenders
tenders.subtitle: Saved tenders and their assessment workspaces.
tenders.emptyBody: Save a tender from Discover tenders to open its assessment workspace.
tenders.notFoundBody: This tender does not exist or does not belong to your company.
tenders.noSummary: No tender summary has been captured yet.

detail.sourceBody: The original source URL and retrieval time are stored with every document and requirement. Open the Documents tab for the evidence of record.
detail.sourceNotRecorded: No external source URL was recorded for this tender. Uploaded documents remain the evidence of record.
detail.sourceSample: This is a synthetic sample uploaded for testing. It has no external source URL and must not be treated as an official tender.
detail.unavailableBody: Reload the page or open another tab.

changesPanel.title: Source changes
changesPanel.subtitle: Snapshots of stored tender fields, rechecked against the source only when you ask.
changesPanel.emptyBody: Capture a baseline snapshot now. When you recheck the source later, field changes appear here.
changesPanel.recheckFailed: The source could not be rechecked.
changesPanel.noChanges: No field changes since the last snapshot.

documentsPanel.title: Tender documents
documentsPanel.subtitle: PDFs attached to this tender. Text is extracted page by page; AI extraction starts only when you run it.
documentsPanel.addSubtitle: Upload the PDF you downloaded from the portal, or the ZIP package the tender was published as. Packages are expanded into their files.
documentsPanel.urlTitle: Or try a direct PDF link
documentsPanel.urlHelp: Portals often block automated downloads. If that happens, download the file in your browser and upload it above.
documentsPanel.fetchBlocked: Automated download blocked. Upload the file instead.
documentsPanel.drop: Drop a PDF or ZIP here, or browse
documentsPanel.supported: PDF, images or a ZIP package, up to 200 MB
documentsPanel.pdfOnly: Only PDF, image and ZIP files are accepted for tender documents.
documentsPanel.tooLarge: Files must be 25 MB or smaller, and a package up to 200 MB.
documentsPanel.chooseFile: Choose a PDF, image or ZIP to upload.
documentsPanel.packageSkipped: {{count}} files in the package were not read
documentsPanel.deleteBody: The PDF, extracted pages and every requirement from it will be removed. This cannot be undone.
documentsPanel.emptyBody: Upload the tender document to extract requirements with page citations.
documentsPanel.noTextHelp: This PDF has no usable text layer and OCR found no English text. Upload a clearer scan or a digital copy.
documentsPanel.pagesSubtitle: This is the text the AI sees and the text every citation is checked against.
documentsPanel.pageNoText: No extractable text on this page.
documentsPanel.sampleNote: This is a clearly labelled synthetic sample created for testing. It is not an official tender.
documentsPanel.uploadedNoTextToast: PDF attached, but no text layer was found.
documentsPanel.ocrPageNote: This page was transcribed with English OCR. Compare it with the page image before relying on a citation.

requirements.title: Extracted requirements
requirements.subtitle: Every item cites a document, page and verbatim excerpt. Unverified means the excerpt did not match the cited page.
requirements.emptyBody: Open Documents, attach the tender PDF, then run Extract requirements.
requirements.ocrPageNote: This page text came from OCR. Check the excerpt visually against the page image before relying on the citation.

evidence.title: Evidence for this requirement
evidence.help: Suggestions use deterministic token matching on your company documents. They are not decisions. Confirm only evidence you have checked yourself.
evidence.noCandidatesBody: Upload a relevant document in the Documents library, then link it here. Unknown stays Unknown until you confirm evidence.

assessment.scoreSubtitle: A transparent soft score. It never overrides a failed or unknown mandatory criterion.
assessment.eligibilitySubtitle: Pass requires human-confirmed valid evidence. Unknown is never treated as a pass.
assessment.noEligibilityBody: Extract tender requirements first. Eligibility items appear only for verified mandatory requirements.
assessment.complianceSubtitle: Tender-specific tasks with source citations, deadlines and cited consequences.
assessment.tasksSubtitle: Generated from extracted requirements. Source fields are never overwritten by later runs.
assessment.noTasksBody: Generate tasks from the extracted requirements. Each task keeps its document, page and clause citation.
assessment.legalSubtitle: Extracted obligations and consequences with citations. This is not legal advice.
assessment.noLegalTitle: No compliance or contract obligations extracted
assessment.noLegalBody: Run requirement extraction on the tender PDF first.
assessment.obligationsSubtitle: Cited obligations that apply after award or during the contract. No deadline is invented; the source trigger is shown when stated.
assessment.noObligationsBody: Generate cited obligations from performance, warranty or contract-stage requirements.

checklist.title: Compliance checklist
checklist.subtitle: Tender-specific tasks with source citations and evidence status.
checklist.emptyBody: Checklist tasks are generated after a tender's requirements are extracted and validated.

changes.title: Changes & alerts
changes.subtitle: Corrigenda, deadline changes and affected requirements.
changes.emptyBody: Once saved tenders are rechecked, source changes and affected tasks will appear here.

discover.title: Discover tenders
discover.subtitle: Search the live web for tenders that match your company profile, with source provenance on every result.
discover.statusBody: Results come from a live TinyFish search and page fetch. Source URLs, retrieval times and retrieval failures are stored with every tender.
discover.unconfiguredBody: Add a TINYFISH_API_KEY to the backend environment to enable live discovery. No sample tenders are ever shown as real results.
discover.runNote: Queries are built from your company profile. Relevance is a profile-fit signal and is separate from mandatory eligibility. Only open tenders with a source-backed closing date or reference are listed; index pages, closed tenders and pages without tender details are kept out.
discover.needProfile: Add sectors, products or keywords to your company profile so discovery has something to match.
discover.emptyBody: This run found no open tender with a source-backed deadline or reference. Index pages, closed tenders and pages without tender details are not listed as tenders — see the sources below.
discover.emptyStored: Run discovery to search the live web for matching tenders.
discover.sourcesHint: Official portals and index pages found during the run. These are not individual tenders, so they are kept out of the tender list.
discover.fromSearchResult: From search result - not opened yet

why.title: Why this run listed nothing
why.body: Every candidate is counted with its reason. Nothing is dropped silently.
why.noWorkMatch: Work did not match your services, sectors or keywords
why.noWorkDescription: Pages that name an authority but no work
why.noDeadline: No closing date found in the source
why.indexPages: Category pages, kept as sources to check
why.notRetrievable: Pages that could not be read

discover.evidenceNote: Verbatim excerpts extracted from the retrieved source text.
discover.noEvidence: No fields could be extracted from the retrieved text.
discover.fetchNote: Details could not be retrieved from this source ({{reason}}). The listing uses the search snippet only.

activity.auth.otp_verified: Email verification or sign-in code used

errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check that the API is running and try again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notFound: The requested page was not found.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.subtitle: Deadlines, tasks and evidence expiry dates derived from your stored records.
reminders.emptyBody: Add a tender deadline, a dated task or an expiring document to generate reminders.
reminders.emailOn: Email delivery is enabled. Run scripts/send-reminders.py --apply to send due reminders.
reminders.emailOff: Email delivery is off. In-app reminders are still shown.
reminders.emailNotConfigured: SMTP is not configured, so no email can be sent yet.
reminders.emailAppMissing: SMTP_APP_PASSWORD is missing on the server.
reminders.note: Reminders are generated from stored deadlines and tasks, not from a background scheduler. Email delivery needs SMTP and the cron-able reminder job.
